current_architecture_identity.control_plane_role: R6 bounded coordination fabric for events, policy narrowing, resource conflict, concurrent scheduling, executor health, queue admission, provider-neutral live dispatch, capability leases, bounded process transport, strict receipt validation, cancellation and timeout reconciliation, typed probe/transport/live-process/capture/result outcomes, append-only reconciliation events, operational memory, snapshot plus tail, compaction, schema migration, namespace isolation, Pack lifecycle, capability revocation, accounting, recovery orchestration, disaster-recovery bundles, driver-readable recovery and repository-local steering of intents, goals, commitments, temporal windows, dependencies, priority, arbitration, decision traces and explainable why-next records; uncertain external effects stop at reconciliation and the Structural Governance Surface remains a cross-cutting advisory overlay, not a hard control-plane authority.
current_architecture_identity.knowledge_role: Knowledge is the first large Domain Pack, not the whole system.
current_architecture_identity.identity_boundary: Ignition owns goal, value, policy, permission, durable state, memory, validation, handoff, provenance and result absorption; Steering records distinguish Owner-declared authority from system proposals, keep Goal dependency separate from Supervisor execution DAGs, and require an independent Completion Contract before completion; Durability / Lifecycle keeps repository-local continuity and recovery records, while uncertain external effects stop at reconciliation and are never rerun automatically; the Live External Executor Bridge issues only bounded synthetic/read-only dispatch with OS permission intersection, disposable workspace binding, sanitized receipts and no channel, browser, remote Git, configuration or new billing authority; the Live Observation / Reconciliation Plane records scoped probe, transport, process, durable capture, structured result, validator and reconciliation states, but reconciliation closure is not success and external effect remains unknown unless independently validated; external Agents perform bounded local actions through adapters. The Structural Governance Surface can expose advisory context but cannot change capability, permission or epistemic status.
current_architecture_identity.authority_ceiling: This is a repository engineering identity. It grants no Owner authority, truth authority, M/E upgrade, production safety, general intelligence or external validity; Steering records model repository-local authority provenance and obligations but do not infer real Owner intent or completion; the Live External Executor Bridge records bounded transport and reconciliation evidence but a provider return or timeout cannot become validated completion without independent OS validation; Durability / Lifecycle is not proof of production durability or external completion, and the advisory Structural Governance Surface is not a new authority layer.

known_open_obligations.statement: The provider-neutral live bridge, durable host-side capture, typed observation outcome projection and append-only reconciliation event overlay are implemented, but no validated live completion was observed. The ledger-derived projection records six attempts: Hermes136 remains effect-unknown after terminal reconciliation; Codex137 failed validation; Codex138 first failed before inference with no structured result; Codex138 second remains terminal observation-incomplete with effect unknown; Task139 closed only its conclusive no-live-dispatch boundary while retaining unknown external effect; and Task140 observed one real Codex process with public probe/transport return code 0, live process return code 1, complete capture and no structured result. LIVE_EXTERNAL_INVOCATION remains open with zero validated completions and zero unreconciled attempts; same-family retry is not authorized, and no production, general-intelligence or external-validity claim is made.
Repository execution evidence does not establish production safety, external validity, Owner acceptance or epistemic acceptance.
Function/non-function registry closure leaves proof, evidence, replication and item-level review obligations independent.
The Structural Governance Surface remains a candidate advisory reading surface; separation from terminology, style, authority escalation and delayed transfer remains open.

Durability / Lifecycle evidence is repository-local continuity and recovery evidence only; schema migration, snapshot restore, disaster-recovery restore, Pack rollback and revocation do not establish production durability, exact-once external execution, Owner acceptance or epistemic acceptance.

Steering / Intent / Goal / Obligation records are repository-local coordination projections; system-derived proposals cannot become Owner authority, a passing run cannot infer goal completion, and offline pilots do not establish live executor completion or epistemic acceptance.

authority_ceilings: OS does not become an executor implementation.
External executors do not own Owner, truth, M/E, Pack, Knowledge or permission authority.
Knowledge Domain Pack validators do not grant generic runtime authority.
Event, policy, resource, scheduler, health, queue, dispatch, memory and console records remain bounded operational projections; none grants truth, Owner, executor or epistemic authority.

Durability / Lifecycle records remain bounded repository-local continuity projections; uncertain external effects stop at reconciliation, and recovery evidence does not establish production durability or exact-once execution.

Steering / Intent / Goal / Obligation records remain bounded repository-local authority, lifecycle and explainability projections; system proposals cannot promote themselves, run-pass cannot infer completion, and no record grants Owner, truth or epistemic authority.

Live External Executor Bridge, capability leases, transport and receipts remain bounded repository-local dispatch/reconciliation projections; no executor output, timeout or captured receipt grants external completion, channel authority, billing authority, Owner authority or epistemic acceptance.
System map and propagation are repository navigation/dependency projections, not reality causality or completeness proof.
Structural Governance Surface is an advisory overlay only; it cannot grant capability, permission, authorization, truth, Owner acceptance, epistemic acceptance or safety release.

architecture_impact_handshake.presentation_only_rule: Presentation-only changes may alter explanation or navigation without changing the identity epoch, system role, ownership, core relations, runtime model or current map identity.
architecture_impact_handshake.no_self_referential_commit_sha: The contract must not contain a self-referential current commit SHA; exact Git evidence belongs in the release receipt and STATE-CHANGELOG delta.
